#QPython SL4A Setup for Once Use
import os,sys,shutil
src = __file__[:__file__.rfind('/')+1]
dst = sys.path[-1] + '/'
ah = 'androidhelper'
for i in os.listdir(src):
    if i in ('setup.py',ah):
        continue
    shutil.copy(src + i, dst + i)
dst += ah
if os.path.exists(dst):
    shutil.rmtree(dst)
shutil.copytree(src + ah,dst)
from androidhelper import Android,sl4a
droid = Android()
rst = {'host' : sl4a.HOST, 'port' : sl4a.PORT, 'handshake' : sl4a.HANDSHAKE}
i = droid.sharedVariableSet('TermuxQSL4AService', str(rst))
shutil.rmtree(src)
print(rst)
print(droid)
print(i, '#sharedVariable')
from fullscreenwrapper import *
i = '"<html>"'
FullScreenWrapper2App.initialize(droid)
print(i, '→', Str2Xml(i))
from android import *
print(droid)
print(droid.getSysInfo())
input('\nSuccess ! Press Enter to Exit .')
